notes: Original title and DOI verified in full author-hosted PDF. Original target identified independently from replication Claim Summary and Black-only sample statement; p. 5 contains multiple studies and tests. Original effect size and p are from the same Table 1 Study 1 Black-participant row. Original n retained as printed condition-specific counts without deriving a total. Replication report Appendix Table 2 assigns N=176 to Good MC-IAT and N=196 to Bad MC-IAT, whereas one-sample test degrees of freedom in the narrative imply reversed condition counts; the explicitly stated overall analytic N=372 is retained.
